content: {"episode_id":"ep-05003","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Please reconsider the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), for which prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting."}
